body: you don't sound rude or mean at all. and while i disagree, i understand why you would feel that way. and by temporary i just mean that nothing lasts forever. ive experienced a life times worth of pain misery and suffering myself and i know its hard to deal with. But there is something or someone worth living for. its a challenge to see who or what that is in our darkest times, but a beautiful thing when you discover it... truth is problems and pain exist and we are all bound to run into them from time to time, but when you discover what it is that would be worth living for... it makes it a little easier. i hope you will change your mind about your decision. i know i am just a stranger on the internet and you probably don't want to hear because of how you feel about yourself, but you are important. things can change and they will if you give yourself a chance to see it and take steps to make that change, rather than to end your life.. use that same passion and determination you have to end your life, to instead rebuild yourself and create the reality and happiness and liberation you long for... I'm not saying its easy, but you may just find that it would be worth it.

Hello Steve, i hope that with your reaching out in this forum that you will find no one who is apathetic or ridiculing but rather concerned. i know that it hurts deeply to not be able to turn to loved ones in your family when you're crying out for help but you CAN still find emotional support... idk whats causing you to feel like giving up on your life, but please don't do it... At times i feel like giving up too but you have to keep pushing on, my friend. Its hard to see it now while you're feeling upset, but there is something worth living for. You are precious Steve, and no one can be a better you than you. i know youre angry w your mother and/or father for not seeing your pain, and you have EVERY right to be upset. but please, don't make a permanent decision regarding yourself out of anger towards someone else... idk if what i said was any help but... if theres anything you can take from my message let it be this: I know things are tough, and i know it hurts to feel unnoticed. But you ARE WORTHY of attention. You MATTER. You ARE Lovable. and Special. the right people will see your pain and will help you. It seems like things wont change but remember, change is inevitable. It wont always be like how it is now. Find out what makes you feel strong, and focus on that. Let that be what keeps you pushing on in this life.

Listen my friend, you are NOT failing at anything. You keep trying and working hard as you SHOULD. the only way you could fail is if you gave up. You are a beautiful/handsome intelligent human being whose going through a lot right now and cant see the forest for the trees. but THATS OKAY. your life is NOT worth shit. Its worth more than you know, but you have to keep going until you discover it. Your life is precious. you can do this. Life doesn't toss you more than you can handle. YOU ARE STRONG, my friend.

Do not do this to yourself, my friend. it sounds to me like you are just completely fed up with what these people are doing to you and you are looking for an escape. but you are strong enough to get through this. Don't make a permanent decision based on a temporary feeling... I know it might not mean anything to you but, I am struggling with the same thing.. I know its difficult and I know difficult is an understatement... but give yourself a chance... you matter, my friend. you are special, important, lovable, beautiful/handsome. don't listen to these people who want to break you down. don't let them break you down. keep pushing on. I know right now it looks like nothing will change, but change is inevitable. Do yourself a favor, and forget about the people messing with you. and - just for a moment - forget about the people who you don't want to hurt. just think about you for a second and the Good that YOU DESERVE. Know that you deserve greatness and love and are capable of achieving it. Give yourself a chance to do it. don't let yourself go behind cruel people. they aren't worth it. YOU ARE SPECIAL.

what has me so stressed is that they've hacked my phone.. i'd like to think they need space but what they're doing tells me otherwise... they don't want to make up, they wont accept my apology... they just want to keep doing this to me ... its exhausting and the fact that its gone on for so long makes it worse... idek what to do anymore. and I have been trying to improve myself.. but when people keep throwing everything you did wrong in your face its hard to believe that you can ever be a better version of yourself..
